name: Abstract API Email Validator
description: Validates email-field input via the Abstract API email-verification service, with a local email/domain blacklist.
project_description: Abstract API Email Validator integrates the third-party Abstract email-verification/validation API into Drupal email fields and forms. Once you supply an Abstract base URL and API key, the module can validate the value of any email-type field (on node, user, paragraph, taxonomy, menu and media entities), the user registration/edit form's mail field, webform email elements, and any custom-form email element flagged with '#abstract_email_validation'. Validation is opt-in per field via a third-party-settings checkbox on the field-config edit form (which adds an 'AbstractEmailValidation' validation constraint) or per element via the '#abstract_email_validation' property. On submit the module calls Abstract with the entered address and accepts or rejects it based on the response: by default it requires is_smtp_valid, a DELIVERABLE deliverability status and quality_score >= 0.8, but a detailed-settings mode lets an administrator choose exactly which of SMTP, MX-found, deliverability and a custom quality-score threshold must hold. A local blacklist can also block specific email addresses or whole domains before the API is ever called, returning a site-admin contact message. All settings live in the abstract_email_validation.settings config object, editable at /admin/config/system/abstract-email-validation.
